rationale: C08 plausibly supplied the concrete drafting template for the child's second section. Both assign a director an obligation to report to the President from time to time and couple that reporting duty with authority, exercised consonant with law, to direct and control executive-branch activities. C04 repeats much of the same machinery and wording but is slightly less close as a single textual model. C09 is substantively related to management improvement and Bureau of the Budget oversight, but its overlap is more programmatic and less textually distinctive.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Director of the Bureau of the Budget shall from time to time report to the President concerning activities carried on by executive agencies and offices with funds allocated hereunder
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Director shall from time to time report to the President concerning his operations under this order
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared reporting formula, including the same official-duty structure, timing phrase, recipient, and subject introduced by “concerning.”

shared_material.child_excerpt: shall, consonant with law, exercise such direction and control with respect to the said activities as he shall deem appropriate
shared_material.parent_excerpt: issue such directives, consonant with law, on policy and operations to the Federal agencies and departments as may be necessary
shared_material.explanation: Both place “consonant with law” inside the director's authority over agency operations; C08 also separately states that agency functions are subject to the director's “direction and control,” closely matching the child's combined formulation.
